description: Remix a creator's open post requests from top performers: each client post request (or idea, with include_ideas) becomes 1-3 drafts modeled on a top-performing reference post (structure, hook, format) and a visual reference, written in the creator's voice and Brain, with a rendered visual that passed auto image QA. Drafts are agency-internal (Team review): the client never sees them until a manager marks them Ready for client. Old drafts for the same request are archived with a reason. Never schedules or publishes. Flow: list, then per request plan, piece for each piece_index, finalize.

action.description: list, then per request: plan, piece (each piece_index; returns when drafted, up to ~5 min), finalize.

include_ideas.description: Also treat unused interview/manual ideas as requests.

piece_index.description: For action piece: which planned piece to draft.

request_ids.description: The request (from action list); the first id is used.

visual.description: For action piece: override the planned visual format.

name: bamf.remix_post_requests
